name: HMT Limited
about: HMT Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of food processing machines in India and internationally. It offers dairy machines, including pasteurizers, cream separators, homogenizers, bottle sterilisers, butter-making machine, centrifugal pumps, plate heat exchangers, non-dairy applications, and watches. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
